verdict.rationale: The docs state that an API key lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, which directly claims UI/API parity. The Computer gateway also exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models, so agent tasks can be driven from any OpenAI-style client. missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec (probes of the docs site's openapi/swagger paths all returned 404), per-feature confirmation that functions such as memory, channels and automations are reachable via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
